'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Jacob Adams DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jacob Adams]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Bladerunner of the 21st Century. Sheet Boba Fett (C.S.F.) (V) → [[Boba Fett (V)]].


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jacob Adams]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
